answer_set.note: the 60 answer-run question IDs (the same in v2, v3, v4a-c and mix); reported, not used

selection.rule: scored (non-abstention) questions not among the answer-set question IDs (414)

arm.method: Engine.search(text, limit=P), rerank_depth 0, no graph arm, as the sweep
arm.store: the sweep's hybrid store build, device check and vector coverage check

rule: REQ40-H4. Pool P0 at k ≤ P0 ranks as the first k of search(limit=P0), measured by calling comp03_answer.retrieve with the fathomdb-hybrid arm at top_k = P for P in {10, 20, 50, 100}. Reference: P0 = 10. Constraints on the selection set: for every type, the session Recall-any@5 and Recall-any@10 counts are at least the reference minus 1; overall, the Recall-any@5, Recall-any@10 and Recall-all@10 counts are at least the reference minus 1. Choice: the largest P0 that meets every constraint; the reference meets them by construction. k = 20 and the answer set are reported, not used.

device.cuda_fallback: refused: a cuda:N request must resolve to an effective CUDA device with a selected UUID

claim_boundary.statement: selects VECTOR_FUSION_POOL for H2; the H2 gate (REQ40-H6) re-measures on the engine
claim_boundary.cost: four store builds per question (one per P), as retrieve builds a fresh store per call
claim_boundary.scope: retrieval only; no answerer or judge
